prereg.question: Measured on hallHpAuc in the R2 regime against a two-ingredient control, does Muddy Bog -- as currently shipped, or with one of two candidate retunes (a footprint margin like Firepit/Steam Vent, or a longer root duration) -- clear the Amendment D contribution floor?
prereg.sigmaSource: hallHpAuc paired delta sd measured in the R2 regime by the registered regime-r2-adoption family (24,000 runs, n=3000/cell, 18/18 gates PASS): ~0.87 (maze A) / ~1.41 (maze B). Maze B is the binding constraint. Identical source and values to fusion-r2-grinder and grinder-r3-worth, deliberately: the regime and control design are unchanged, only the structure under test differs.

regime.label: R2
regime.justification: R2 carried unchanged from fusion-r2-grinder, grinder-r3-worth and every prior fusion-worth family, for the same reason: R1 stops at wave 8 and never sees the elites at 9-10, and R1's maze-A ceiling crushed the top Watchtower-ladder rung to +0.0011, nearly blind to the defence getting BETTER. The control arm uses partnerSpecial: WATER, which buys the partner special at the fusion's own anchor tile and DECLINES the fusion proposal, so the control holds BOTH ingredients standing (the same control design as fusion-r2-muddy-bog and bog-decouple-retune).
regime.scopeLimit: FOUR limits, carried from grinder-r3-worth. (1) R2 trades terminal survival for reach: only 0-7% of runs end with the hall alive, so hallHpFrac, win rate and every other TERMINAL measure are floor-censored and BARRED here; hallHpAuc is exempt as an integral over waves played, and wavesCleared is secondary despite being nearer a terminal measure. (2) The CROSS-POLICY GATE IS EMPTY -- only scripted-v1 exists -- so every verdict here is provisional on it. (3) humanElement confounds any cross-family comparison: this family measures ONLY whether a Muddy Bog variant beats ITS OWN control, never a ranking against fusions in other families. (4) This family CANNOT attribute a PASS between the margin change and the root change if both happened to pass -- each is tested as its own single-lever arm against the shared control precisely so it CAN be attributed; a future combined arm would need its own family.

prereg.decisionRule:
Paired delta, each of {muddy-bog, muddy-bog-margin, muddy-bog-longroot} minus control, on hallHpAuc, per maze, evaluated independently per arm.

PASS (clears the Amendment D contribution floor): for a given arm, delta > 0 AND BH-adjusted q < 0.05 across the declared family of 18 AND the exact sign test agrees in direction AND the verdict survives hang-imputation at the cell minimum. Per Philip's 2026-08-04 ruling, PASSING ON EITHER MAZE IS SUFFICIENT for that arm -- maze A is substantially easier than maze B and requiring both would force overtuning.

FAIL (retune target, that specific lever): delta < 0 under those same gates on either maze, with no PASS on the other, for that arm.

UNRESOLVED: anything else, for that arm. Not a pass, not a fail; no balance change follows from an unresolved cell.

SPLIT-HALF IS DECLARED UNINFORMATIVE AND IS NOT A GATE, exactly as in grinder-r3-worth and steam-vent-retune: with a two-value scale per arm-vs-control comparison, splitForMetric ranks nothing informative. Reported for the record only.

MONOTONICITY RULE: not applicable. The three non-control arms are not a dose ladder -- they are three structurally distinct, unordered interventions (ship-as-is, add a footprint margin, lengthen root) -- so there is no ordering to disqualify on. Each is judged solely against control.

CROSS-POLICY GATE NOT MET: only scripted-v1 exists. Every verdict from this family is PROVISIONAL on that gate, declared here rather than discovered later.
prereg.whatWouldRefute: For any one arm, a delta whose BH-adjusted q exceeds 0.05 on both mazes refutes a PASS claim for that specific variant. A resolvably negative delta on either maze with no PASS on the other refutes that variant's design premise and marks it (not the whole fusion) as a retune target. If ALL THREE arms fail to clear the floor on both mazes, that refutes the working hypothesis of this whole family -- that the floor-clearing gap is closeable by tuning Bog's own dials -- and returns the question to the mechanic-review track the 2026-08-28 review originally called for, this time on solid registered ground. If every arm comes back unresolvable against control on both mazes at n>=3121, that refutes the claim that hallHpAuc at this n can resolve a single-fusion trade in R2, and the response is to raise n rather than declare anything balanced.
prereg.notes:
WHY THIS FAMILY EXISTS. Muddy Bog is the only fusion in the six-fusion roster still measured negative against the two structures it consumes: +0.079 (A) / -0.147 (B), from the 2026-08-28 confirmation sweep (bog-decouple-retune, 750 seeds x 2 postGaps = 1500 cells/arm/maze, UNREGISTERED). That sweep's own review concluded 'damage saturates, root saturates, this needs a mechanic review, not another dial' -- but that conclusion was measured while Bog's damage was gated behind its own root. That coupling was removed in commit 9ee93ad (2026-08-29): damage is now gated on footprint PRESENCE only, independent of root, and pulse.damage was raised 12 -> 28 in the same commit. The 'saturates both ways' finding describes a mechanic that no longer exists, so the correct first step is to re-measure under registered conditions rather than start a redesign.

WHY THREE ARMS, NOT ONE. The existing damage dial was already swept nearly exhaustively (bog-decouple-retune: pulse.damage 1-32, 16 arms, 48000 runs) and does not hold flat -- it oscillates within about +-0.11 on maze B from 8 to 26, then jumps sharply between 26 (-0.013) and 27 (+0.203), a genuine discrete threshold (docs/reviews/2026-08-28-fusion-roster-worth-retune.md, balance.js TOWER.MUDDY_BOG comment). 28 is one step past that threshold and is already the best value found in that range; pushing the same dial further is not a promising next lever. Two dials Bog has NEVER been tested against are: (1) marginPx, a footprint-expansion field Firepit (marginPx:15) and Steam Vent (cloudMarginPx:15) both have and Bog previously had no code path for at all -- added 2026-08-30 (server/game/towers.js's areaRect call site, shared/balance.js MUDDY_BOG.marginPx, default 0/off) specifically to make this arm possible; and (2) root.msByWeight, which controls how long an enemy is held on the (now damage-gated-on-presence) footprint and therefore how many 500ms pulses it eats per crossing -- a lever that was entangled with the old root-gated-damage mechanic and may behave completely differently now that root's only job is dwell time, not a damage gate.

ARM DEFINITIONS. muddy-bog: current shipped config verbatim (pulse.damage 28, marginPx 0, root.msByWeight [600,1200,1800,2400]) -- re-measures the exact configuration the stale verdict was about, this time registered. muddy-bog-margin: balanceOverrides TOWER.MUDDY_BOG.marginPx 0->15, matching Firepit/Steam Vent's value exactly rather than inventing a new one. muddy-bog-longroot: balanceOverrides TOWER.MUDDY_BOG.root.msByWeight all four tiers x1.5 (600->900, 1200->1800, 1800->2700, 2400->3600), a uniform scale-up chosen so the ordering across weight tiers is unchanged and the change is describable in one sentence, not a per-tier hand-tune.

EXPECTATION, STATED IN ADVANCE so it cannot be read as confirmation afterwards. muddy-bog (baseline) is expected to reproduce something close to +0.079 (A) / -0.147 (B) -- i.e. likely FAIL or UNRESOLVED, not a surprise PASS, because this is the same configuration the unregistered probe already measured; registering it closes the loose end rather than expecting a different number. margin and longroot are both genuinely open: margin is a direct structural analogue of the fix that made the Grinder pass (holding an enemy inside its own damage zone, where Bog previously had a bare 2x2 with literally zero halo), and longroot is a direct analogue too (more pulses landed per crossing, now that damage isn't itself capped by root). Neither has ever been measured, in any regime, at any n.

SAMPLE SIZE. 1600 seeds x 2 postGaps = 3200 cells per arm per maze, against nRequired 3121 for MDE 0.10 on maze B (stats.js requiredN(1.41, 0.10)), identical derivation to grinder-r3-worth. 4 arms (1 control + 3 treatment) x 2 mazes x 3200 = 25600 runs.

familySize is declared as 18 = 3 non-control arms x 2 mazes x 3 metrics (primary + 2 secondary), the full width of this family's own hypothesis space. Not padded against any other family, since this question is self-contained and not being split across sessions the way the Grinder's root/worth split was.

No balance change ships directly from this family. A PASS on margin or longroot identifies a retune worth landing; any actual balance.js change is a separate, deliberate follow-up commit that also updates the pinned pulse.damage/root.msByWeight values test in test/game/muddyBog.test.js:341-349.
